title: 第七章 清风观
content_zh:
李火旺身穿着医院专用的束缚衣躺在床上，默默地看着头顶上用吊瓶的挂钩，似乎在等待着什么。
“吱嘎”一声，病房的门
李火旺的主治医生走了进来，一脸失望的看着他。
听到这话，脑袋被白纱布包住的李火旺顿时一急，开口解释道：“医生，是他们对杨娜先动手！我这是为了保护她才被迫出手反击他们的！”
医生食指弯曲推了推脸上的眼镜，“你那叫反击吗？你这叫反杀！刘建业现在可躺在ICU没出来呢，你那一脚差点把他直接送走，你也是在这里呆了不少时间了，大家的事情都知道，动手前难道就没有考虑到刘师傅的病情吗？我原本以为你是一个懂事的孩子。”
想到被吓得梨花带雨的杨娜，李火旺显得有些不服气，“他神经病怎么了？得了神经病就可以为所欲为吗？要是在杨娜受伤害跟坐牢里面选，我宁愿选后者。”
“你--”主治医生被李火旺怼的说不出话来。
他最终叹气了摇了摇头，“算了算了，院长已经打电话给双方家属了，这些事情就不用你操心了。”
李火旺听到这话，微微蜷曲身体向着无人的另外一侧侧躺，心里开始估算那价值40万的玉佩够不够赔偿的。
不过此时的他一点都不慌，当看到那丹药真的有作用后，李火旺忽然发现自己的人生多了很多种新选择。
感觉到自己小患者的情绪不高，医生开口安抚到：“小李啊，别担心，你不会坐牢的，院内可以给你开证了，别想这些了，安心养病，其他的事情，我们会处理好的。”
李火旺察觉到了医生话语间对自己的关切，“谢谢你，医生。”
“谢什么，谁让我是你的主治医生呢。你又这么小，当然要对你多照顾了。”李火旺感觉到对方的手在自己肩膀上拍了拍。
“不过啊小李，你实话告诉我，当时你是怎么把他们伤成那样的？那可不是一般人能办到的？你当时是正常状态呢，还是说又陷入了什么新的应激幻觉？”
听到这话，李火旺心中一紧，注意力马上集中在自己上衣的口袋。“那个....我......”
“我是搞心理的，而且对这方面还颇有心得，别想隐瞒病情，你最好想好了再回答，我很讨厌我的患者欺骗我。”
虽然医生的语气和颜悦色，可是李火旺却感觉到房间内那无形的压力，“怎么办呢，丹药的事情不能让他知道啊。”
就在李火旺焦急的寻找着脱困办法的时候，四周的一切开始变得不稳定，医生的声音也变得越来越朦胧。
没过几秒，他发现自己再次陷入幻觉，躺在了玄阳的单间溶洞的石床上。
捂着脑袋坐起来，李火旺看着四周简陋的摆设笑了起来。“嘿嘿，不管怎么样，这也是一种解决办法。”

他这次不打算那么快回去了，免得医生守在旁边没走。
从房间走出来，李火旺看着溶洞隧道内进进出出的师兄弟们，心中开始估算接下来自己打算。
既然那些丹药是真的，那么自己就不能像之前那么随意了，必须好好运营这里才行，以求从这地方薅出更多的羊毛。
好在自己现在的身份不再是料房的药引，而变成了癞子头记名弟子，在行动方面自由了许多。
当看到一位同样身穿道袍的留须道士从自己面前走过，李火旺眼前一亮，连忙追了过去。“这位师兄，这位师兄！”
那位留须道士扭头发现说话的是李火旺，态度不平不淡。“玄阳师弟，何事？”
李火旺学着他们说话的样子回答道：“师弟刚刚成为师傅的弟子，还请师兄解惑，我接下来该做些什么？”
“别怪师兄说话不好听，虽说你是师傅他老人家亲自收入门下，可你资历最浅，现在也就只能在清风观内跑腿。”
“想让师傅教授成仙道法，那是关门弟子才有的待遇，你还不够格。现在先随我去丹房外候着。”
“成仙....？”李火旺喃喃自语地说道，他可从来没有听说过有哪位神仙成仙是拿人炼丹炼出来的。
“师傅真的能成仙？”
留须道士脸上露出一丝自满。“那是当然，师傅可是有大神通的人，好好伺候着就是。”
从这位叫玄阴的师兄口中，李火旺也弄清了整个溶洞道馆内的人员构成，记名弟子一共五位，亲传门弟子一位，观主也就是丹阳子一位。
除了这些人之外，剩下的人都是一些外围人员，比如做饭的伙夫，料房的药引，干杂货的道童等，这些人加起来有个百八十号人。
这是李火旺第一次对整个道馆有全新的了解，道馆人数比较少，甚至可以说得上简陋，尤其是不久前死了一大批之后。
交谈间，那座充满压抑的丹炉再次出现在李火旺的面前，渺渺白烟从炉内飘，似乎在练着什么东西。
这次丹炉除了丹阳子外，还有他的关门弟子一位表情阴郁的青年。
跟着玄阴在旁边候了一会，李火旺接到了自己的活，拿着料单去料房清点配料，就跟当初的玄阳干的活一样。
当拿着白色浮尘的李火旺来到料房，正在干活的所有人都看了过来，紧张的眼神中带上一丝害怕。
那位白化少女抿着嘴唇迫切地上前两步，但是最终什么话都没说缓缓畏惧退了回去。

对方的身份已经从被压迫者变成了压迫者。
李火旺望着他们思绪活络了起来，他双方的身份已经发生了变化，自己或许可以从这方面找点好处。
“那个，你们身上有钱吗？”这话一出所有人都愣住了。“钱啊，听不懂吗？就是银子，金子玉佩也行。”
说真的，李火旺现在蛮需要钱的，老刘头的赔偿金还不知道需要多少，自己家只是普通家庭，要是赔偿大的话，妈恐怕就要卖房了，这是他迫切需要的。
“反正在这里也花不了，不如都给我吧，这算保护费，以后你们我罩了。”
话说得这么直白，其他人也听懂了，料房里的人开始在身上摸索起来。他们不求李火旺保护他们，只求交了东西别欺负他们。
半块拇指大小的发黑碎银子，一根铜簪子，四十几个外圆内方的铜钱，这就是他的所有收获了。
望着这些东西李火旺唉声叹气，自己似乎打错算盘了，这些家伙哪里还有什么钱啊，这些东西换的钱估计还没有自己医保卡上的多。
content_en:
Li Huowang was lying on the bed wearing a hospital-specific straitjacket, silently looking at the hook for a hanging bottle above his head, as if waiting for something.
With a "creak" sound, the door of the ward
Li Huowang's attending doctor came in and looked at him with disappointment.
Hearing this, Li Huowang, whose head was wrapped in white gauze, suddenly became anxious and explained: "Doctor, they were the ones who attacked Yang Na first! I was forced to fight back against them to protect her!"
The doctor curled his index finger and pushed up the glasses on his face, "Do you call that a counterattack? You call that a counterattack! Liu Jianye is lying in the ICU and has not come out. Your kick almost sent him away. You have been here for a long time. Everyone knows everything. Didn't you consider Master Liu's condition before taking action? I originally thought you were a sensible child."
Thinking of the frightened Yang Na, Li Huowang seemed a little unconvinced, "What's wrong with his psychosis? Can he do whatever he wants if he's a psychopath? If I had to choose between Yang Na getting hurt or going to jail, I'd rather choose the latter."
"You--" The attending doctor was speechless by Li Huowang.
He finally sighed and shook his head, "Forget it, the dean has already called the families of both parties, so you don't need to worry about these things."
When Li Huowang heard this, he curled up slightly and lay on the other side where there was no one. He began to estimate in his mind whether the jade pendant worth 400,000 yuan was enough to compensate him.
But at this time, he was not panic at all. After seeing that the elixir really worked, Li Huowang suddenly found that his life had many new choices.
Feeling that his little patient was not in a high mood, the doctor said to reassure him: "Xiao Li, don't worry, you won't go to jail. The hospital can issue a certificate for you. Don't think about it. Recuperate in peace. We will take care of other things."
Li Huowang noticed the doctor's concern for him in his words, "Thank you, doctor."
"Thank you, who made me your attending doctor? You are so young, of course I have to take more care of you." Li Huowang felt the other party's hand patting his shoulder.
"But Xiao Li, tell me the truth, how did you hurt them like that? That's not something ordinary people can do? Were you in a normal state at the time, or did you fall into some new stress hallucination?"
Hearing this, Li Huowang's heart tightened, and his attention immediately focused on the pockets of his jacket. "That...I..."
"I'm a psychiatrist, and I have quite a lot of experience in this area. Don't try to hide your condition. You'd better think carefully before answering. I hate it when my patients deceive me."
Although the doctor's tone was pleasant, Li Huowang felt the invisible pressure in the room, "What should we do? We can't let him know about the pill."
Just as Li Huowang was anxiously looking for a way out of trouble, everything around him began to become unstable, and the doctor's voice became increasingly hazy.
Within a few seconds, he found himself falling into hallucination again, lying on the stone bed of Xuanyang's single-room cave.
Li Huowang sat up and covered his head, looking at the simple furnishings around him and laughing. "Hey, no matter what, this is also a solution."
He didn't plan to go back so soon this time, lest the doctor would stay by his side.
Walking out of the room, Li Huowang looked at the brothers and sisters walking in and out of the cave tunnel, and began to calculate his next plan in his mind.
Since those pills are real, then I can't be as casual as before. I must run this place well in order to get more wool from this place.
Fortunately, my current identity is no longer the Yaoyin of the restaurant, but a registered disciple of Lezitou, which gives me a lot of freedom in action.
When he saw a bearded Taoist priest who was also wearing Taoist robes walking past him, Li Huowang's eyes lit up and he quickly chased after him. "This teacherBrother, this senior brother! "
The bearded Taoist priest turned around and found that the person speaking was Li Huowang, with an unflattering attitude. "Junior brother Xuanyang, what's the matter? "
Li Huowang imitated the way they talked and replied: "Junior brother has just become the master's disciple. Please ask him to clarify his doubts. What should I do next? "
"Don't blame senior brother for speaking poorly. Although you are a master and he has personally accepted you as his disciple, you are the most junior and can only run errands in Qingfeng Temple now. "
"If you want your master to teach you how to become an immortal, that's the kind of treatment only close disciples get, and you're not qualified. Now follow me to wait outside the alchemy room. "
"Become an immortal...? "Li Huowang murmured to himself, but he had never heard of any immortal being made by using human elixirs to refine it.
"Can Master really become an immortal? "
There was a hint of complacency on the bearded Taoist priest's face. "Of course, the master is a person with great supernatural powers, so just take good care of him. "
From the mouth of this senior brother named Xuanyin, Li Huowang also found out the composition of the entire Karst Cave Gym. There were five named disciples, one direct disciple, and the master of the temple was Danyangzi.
In addition to these people, the remaining people are peripheral personnel, such as the cooks, the cooks in the cooking room, the Taoist boys who do the groceries, etc. There are a hundred and eighty people in total.
This is the first time that Li Huowang has a new understanding of the entire gym. The number of people in the gym is relatively small, and it can even be said to be simple, especially after a large number of people died not long ago.
During the conversation, the depressing alchemy furnace appeared in front of Li Huowang again. White smoke floated from the furnace, as if he was practicing something.
This time, in addition to Danyangzi, there was also a young man with a gloomy expression who was one of his close disciples.
After Xuanyin waited nearby for a while, Li Huowang received his job and took the ingredient list to the material room to count the ingredients, just like Xuanyang did before.
When Li Huowang came to the material room with the white dust in his hand, everyone who was working looked over, with a hint of fear in their nervous eyes.
The albino girl pursed her lips and took two steps forward eagerly, but in the end she slowly backed away in fear without saying anything.
The identity of the other party has changed from oppressed to oppressor.
Li Huowang's thoughts became more active as he looked at them. Their identities had changed, and he might be able to find some benefits from this.
"Um, do you have any money on you? "Everyone was stunned when these words came out. "Qian, don't you understand? Even silver, gold and jade pendants will do. "
To be honest, Li Huowang is in great need of money now. He doesn't know how much compensation Lao Liu will need. His family is just an ordinary family. If the compensation is large, his mother may have to sell the house. This is what he urgently needs.
"You can't spend it here anyway, so why not give it all to me? This counts as protection money, and I'll cover you from now on. "
The words were so straightforward that others understood, and the people in the cooking room began to grope around on his body. They didn't ask Li Huowang to protect them, they just asked not to bully them after handing over something.
Half a piece of broken black silver the size of a thumb, a copper hairpin, and more than forty copper coins with a round outside and a square inside. This was all he gained.
Looking at these things, Li Huowang sighed. He seemed to have made the wrong calculation. How could these guys have any money? The money exchanged for these things was probably not as much as what was on his own medical insurance card.
